blocks.text: HANOI – Less than a month after putting the plan up for public consultation, the local authorities have decided to go ahead with a massive redevelopment of the area around Hoan Kiem Lake in central Hanoi. On Oct 27, the Hanoi People’s Committee submitted an investment proposal worth more than 22 trillion dong ($855 million)
